en: Color postcard showing the richly carved wooden Dining Room of Peleș Castle, with a long table set with candelabra, high-backed chairs on both sides, elaborate coffered ceiling and chandeliers. The reverse reads "CARTE POȘTALĂ," includes multilingual captions identifying the scene as the Dining Room of the Peleș Museum in Sinaia, and credits the publisher Editura Meridiane and photographer Al. Comănescu with a printed price.
